chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Rib'i ibn 'Abd Allah, from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
When 'Ali ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام would stand in salat (prayer), his color would change; and when he prostrated, he would not raise his head until he was dripping with sweat.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual act of worship in which the Imam stood
key_terms.تَغَيَّرَ: changed, indicating a visible transformation in his state
key_terms.سَجَدَ: he prostrated, meaning he entered sajdah (prostration)
key_terms.عَرَقًا: sweat, indicating the intensity and duration of his devotion
key_terms.لَوْنُهُ: his color, referring to his complexion changing from awe
key_terms.يَرْفَعْ: he raised, referring to lifting his head from sajdah (prostration)

ai.seo_question: How did Imam 'Ali ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام behave during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the state of intense humility, awe, and devotion of 'Ali ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام during salat (prayer). It portrays his deep spiritual absorption in worship, especially in standing and sajdah (prostration).
